text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Cesario!
She's put on an incredible display of skill~!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text: Man, I'm really looking forward to what she does next!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (The first move to reach the far-off future.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(The result was great.
First, I've etched my presence into their minds.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (However—)
“—A true rising star! If any words could describe Cesario's debut race, those are certainly the ones!”

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you,
Trainer.

I cannot hold back this surging excitement.
Now then, where should our next stage be...?!
There are several graded races considered prep races for the Oka Sho.
choice_data_list: Which race does Cesario want to enter?

text_block_list.text: When I asked and looked at her face—she was pale.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "Trainer. Before we discuss the next race, may I make a report?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
…………
...There's a slight discomfort in my legs.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
To get straight to the point, inflammation has occurred
in your sesamoid bone and ligament.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Accumulated strain from posture, or perhaps her body simply couldn't keep up with her advancing technique...
Either way, it is likely to become chronic.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Always ice her legs without fail after races
and training. And please make sure she uses
custom-made horseshoes.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't recommend it for a while.
At least until the pain subsides...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: No... ngh.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I've heard that you've only just made
your debut in the Twinkle Series, but—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"Leg injuries are
an extremely common reason for retirement."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"It may feel frustrating, but please always exercise
careful judgment when choosing training regimens
and entering races."
The trip back turned out to be a quiet one.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...I am... truly sorry...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
Even if you're careful, there are some things you just can't prevent.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "...I understand that, but... just when things were finally getting started...!"

...It's only natural. Right after her debut race,
she was diagnosed with an injury that could affect her future.
It must be hard for her to look forward right now.

Even if it's just a temporary fix.
Anything to help her get some of her spirit back—
choice_data_list: ...How about we go grab something delicious to eat?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: It's delicious...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —Ah! S-Sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Even though it must be hard on you too, Trainer...
I'm so sorry for making you worry about me...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, I—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...There is no need to worry.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry
for doing nothing but whine.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...She was a bit downcast,
but that doesn't mean she can't run.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "Let's rework the upcoming rotation tomorrow in the Trainer's Office."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I will formulate a clear strategy
to claim the Triple Tiara with these legs.

In the end, we decided to head
straight home afterward—
As if the quiet journey home had been an illusion, she straightened her posture, and our discussion began.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Let's set our next target race for one year from now: the Flower Cup.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I hope we can provide care and make
adjustments to her legs before then."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: May I hear your thoughts on this, Trainer?

The "Flower Cup" is an 1800m GⅢ race.
For a trial race leading up to the Oka Sho, the first leg of the Triple Tiara,
it is on the longer side.

Cesario's goal is to achieve the Triple Tiara.
The Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks) in particular is one she cannot afford to miss.
"She probably wants to challenge this distance with an eye towards the Oaks."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. In that case,
our target race shall be the Flower Cup.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Next, let us discuss future leg care.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "It's just a rough outline, I'm afraid, but here is a summary of our leg care policy and training plan for the coming year—"

Even though she must have been in shock,
she bounced back in just a day and is already looking ahead.
If I try to encourage her, it just makes her apologize.

I didn't even notice something was bothering her leg
until she brought it up herself.
It was only natural that she hesitated to speak on the Shinkansen. After all, I'm not yet adequate as someone who can support her.
choice_data_list: (As a Trainer, I must grow stronger quickly.)
(As a Trainer, I need to grow quickly.)

text_block_list.text:
"To be a warm, sunlit spot when light is sought,
and a cool shade when shadow is desired—
that is what I wish to be."

At the very least... I want to be a Trainer
who can spot when she's off her game at a glance.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
――Heading into the "Flower Cup" a year from now,
there is much to be done.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll give it my all...!

text_block_list.text:
Our next target race is the Flower Cup.
I don't want to just be a trainer who only
repeats the word "magnificent" anymore...!
